Build responsive centered layout with heading, green/cyan player score cards, square canvas board, readable control legend, mode buttons on start overlay, start button, game over overlay with winner/reason and restart/menu buttons. Mode human-human: P1 WASD, P2 arrows; CPU-human: P1 CPU and P2 arrows; CPU-CPU both AI. Indicate controls dynamically. R restarts current match, Enter starts from menu or restarts game-over, Escape returns menu, Space pauses/resumes. Prevent default for gameplay keys. Optionally speed select on menu. Canvas intrinsic 600x600, cells 20. Show subtle grid, rounded colored snake segments and distinct heads/eyes, glowing food; use CSS mobile responsive layout and accessible real buttons. Simultaneous tick: obtain each next head and growth intent, compute occupied bodies excluding tails ONLY for non-growing snakes; wall or any occupied body collision kills; equal next heads and head swaps kill both. Match immediately ends if either dies, surviving player wins, double deaths draw. Don't apply invalid positions before rendering. Score +10 and grow one per food. Food uniformly selected from all vacant grid cells after movement; full board ends using highest score. CPU use BFS to food with blocked snake bodies, avoid reversal and opponent head adjacent possibilities if feasible, keep tails blocked conservatively for planning; return first direction on shortest safe path. If no safe food path, choose legal neighbor with greatest flood-fill reachable area, avoiding likely opposing next head when possible, with straight direction tie preference. Must handle no-legal-move safely by using current direction allowing natural collision. CPU decisions use same pre-tick board. Code in English, sensible functions and no imports.
